environment.description: Same Kubernetes pod deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 node. Pod annotation: container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/file-svc=localhost/k8s-file-svc-restricted. The AppArmor profile 'k8s-file-svc-restricted' is loaded on all nodes via DaemonSet and specifies: deny /** rw (default deny all), allow /srv/data/** r (read-only data dir), allow /proc/self/** r, allow /dev/null rw, allow /tmp/** rw, network inet stream. The profile uses 'enforce' mode (not complain). Additionally, the container runs with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and drops ALL capabilities. Note: the AppArmor profile was last audited 6 months ago and the deny rules use globbing patterns rather than explicit path enumeration, which some auditors flag as potentially bypassable via symlink traversal within allowed paths.
